currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Estádio Beira-Rio renovated stadium: own mapped oval body/open oval roof aperture and separate field-axis control, pale curved fabric petals with tapered lower gaps/continuous rounded shoulder and canopy/renderable closed backs, exposed radial steel/deep inner oval truss/local supports, recessed lower concrete/glazed service frontage/concourse decks/neutral entries, two red seating tiers/central closed hospitality belt/pale aisles/open neutral football floor and supported displays/lights/marks/goals. Closeup uses65 radial modules following the primary designers65-truss concept; exact textile-panel/connection inventory is not claimed. Four existing shared concrete/paint/canvas/window-grid graphs; no unique atlas/copied lettering/event lighting/hidden furnished rooms. Far levels merge petal/frame/tread repetitions and expand the simplified seating opening to keep the complete field clear. Adjacent arena/parking garage/other site buildings and proposed redevelopment remain separate native context.
